win.displays.writeFailed: Could not change the brightness of this display.
win.displays.pageDescription: Brightness for the built-in and external displays, from the panel or with shortcuts.
win.displays.disabledCaption: Turn on “Control displays” to change brightness here and in the tray panel.
win.displays.followPointerCaption: The brightness shortcuts change the display under the pointer instead of the main display.
win.displays.softwareCaption: This display does not accept brightness commands, so the slider dims the picture instead.
win.displays.dimCaption: This monitor accepts brightness commands without confirming them. If the slider has no effect, dim the picture instead.
win.displays.extraDimmingCaption: The lowest quarter of the slider dims the picture after the monitor reaches its minimum.
brightness.enableCaption: Brightness controls for the built-in and external displays, here and in the tray panel.
brightness.keyStepCaption: Smaller steps for each press of the display brightness shortcuts.
brightness.osdCaption: Shows the brightness percentage when you use the shortcuts or the sliders.
brightness.displayBrightnessShortcutCapt: Shortcuts adjust the main display, or the display under the pointer when “Shortcuts follow the pointer” is on.
